infrastructure.tagline: Building with Precision. Delivering with Purpose.
overview: Hayvora Infrastructure Ltd is a multidisciplinary civil and architectural construction company committed to delivering durable, innovative, and client-centred built environments. As a core division under Hayvora Holdings Ltd, we focus on both public and private sector projects, offering a comprehensive range of services from structural works to turnkey interior finishes — with a strong emphasis on quality control, safety, and timely delivery.
From foundational works to final finishes, Hayvora Infrastructure integrates technology, technical expertise, and a skilled workforce to bring your vision to life.
infrastructure.vision: To be a trusted leader in delivering resilient, sustainable, and innovative infrastructure solutions across Ghana and West Africa.
infrastructure.mission: To construct with excellence, engineer with integrity, and innovate with purpose — ensuring our clients receive value-driven and future-ready infrastructure services.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: We build trust by being transparent, honest, and accountable in all dealings — with clients, suppliers, and stakeholders.

values.title: Excellence
values.description: We pursue outstanding results through high-quality workmanship, project efficiency, and a culture of continuous improvement.

values.title: Professionalism
values.description: We uphold industry standards, communicate clearly, and execute with discipline and technical competence.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM), modern tools, and sustainable construction practices to enhance value and efficiency.

values.title: Our People
values.description: We empower our team through training, fair labour practices, and a shared mission to deliver results.

values.title: Safety
values.description: We maintain strict health, safety, and environmental practices across every project site and office operation.

infrastructure.servicesIntro: We deliver tailored infrastructure solutions for developers, contractors, NGOs, institutions, and public works authorities.

services.title: Civil & Structural Works
services.description: We construct durable and efficient load-bearing systems for all types of buildings and infrastructure projects.

services.title: Architectural & Design Support
services.description: We partner with architects and planners to bring designs to life from the ground up.

services.title: Interior Finishing & Fit-Out Works
services.description: We elevate spaces through detailed finishing and interior expertise.

services.title: MEP Services & Installations
services.description: We ensure the functionality and efficiency of your built environment.

services.title: Material Supply & Labour Brokerage
services.description: We support contractors and developers with logistics and manpower.
items: Supply of construction materials (blocks, cement, steel, aggregates, etc.)
Skilled labour outsourcing (masons, carpenters, steel fixers, tilers, painters)

infrastructure.operationalNote: Crews, plant and supervision are mobilised from Accra, with project teams placed on site for the duration of the build.

jhm-geo-consult.tagline: Mapping the Future. Engineering with Purpose.
overview: JHM Geo Consult is a dynamic spatial and engineering services company offering cutting-edge geospatial, environmental, and civil engineering solutions. As a strategic division under Hayvora Holdings Ltd, we provide accurate data, sustainable designs, and technical insights to support infrastructure development, land administration, and environmental compliance across Ghana and West Africa.
We bridge the gap between land, technology, and development by combining modern surveying tools with practical engineering expertise — ensuring our clients build on a foundation of certainty.
jhm-geo-consult.vision: To be the most trusted provider of integrated geospatial and engineering solutions that empower progress and informed decision-making across Africa.
jhm-geo-consult.mission: To deliver reliable, precise, and technology-driven geo-engineering services that enhance infrastructure, protect the environment, and support sustainable development.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: We are committed to data transparency, regulatory compliance, and delivering unbiased, accurate reporting that builds client trust.

values.title: Excellence
values.description: We deliver every project with scientific accuracy, modern methodology, and an unwavering commitment to detail.

values.title: Professionalism
values.description: We uphold professional standards, certifications, and best practices in surveying, engineering, and environmental assessments.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We use drone mapping, GIS, advanced modelling, and digital workflows to deliver timely and actionable insights.

values.title: Our People
values.description: Our team of licensed surveyors, engineers, and analysts collaborate with purpose and technical leadership to exceed expectations.

values.title: Safety
values.description: We operate with safety-first practices — from remote drone flights to field data capture — while minimizing environmental and human risks.

jhm-geo-consult.servicesIntro: We serve construction companies, developers, municipalities, NGOs, and private landowners.

services.title: Land & Engineering Surveying
services.description: Accurate, on-site measurements for development, title registration, and construction control.

services.title: Geodetic & GIS Services
services.description: Advanced mapping and spatial analysis for decision-making and design support.

services.title: Environmental & Hydrographic Surveys
services.description: Insightful evaluations of land, water, and ecological systems for development and compliance.
items: Monitoring of natural resources and wetlands

services.title: Utility Detection & Subsurface Mapping
services.description: Non-destructive location of buried services and potential hazards.

services.title: Geotechnical & Site Investigation
services.description: Subsurface exploration for safe and cost-effective foundation and construction planning.

services.title: Construction Engineering Support
services.description: Providing precision and insights for construction execution and verification.

services.title: Technical Training & Capacity Building
services.description: Empowering institutions and professionals in modern geo-engineering tools and standards.
items: Survey equipment usage and field training
Engineering and environmental data analysis workshops

jhm-geo-consult.operationalNote: Survey crews and instruments mobilise from Accra, with data processing and reporting handled in-house.

overview: AgriSystem & Analytics is the Hayvora Holdings division working where agriculture meets evidence. We build the physical systems that let growers produce reliably — protected growing structures and the irrigation that feeds them — and we provide the data services that let programmes prove what those investments achieved.

That pairing is deliberate. A greenhouse without a water plan underperforms, and a development programme without clean field data cannot report on its own results. We work across both, from a first site visit through to the endline report.
agrisystem-analytics.vision: To make climate-smart growing systems affordable for African producers, and to make the results of agricultural development measurable and trustworthy.
agrisystem-analytics.mission: To design and build practical growing infrastructure, and to collect, verify, and analyse the field data that turns agricultural programmes into evidence.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: We report what the data shows. Figures are traceable to the field record that produced them, and we do not adjust findings to suit an expected result.

values.title: Excellence
values.description: Structures are built to hold up through a full season and beyond; datasets are cleaned, validated, and documented well enough for someone else to audit.

values.title: Professionalism
values.description: We follow accepted monitoring and evaluation practice, agree indicators and methods before fieldwork begins, and deliver in the formats funders require.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We favour low-cost, locally maintainable designs and digital data capture over expensive imported systems and paper forms.

values.title: Our People
values.description: Our agronomists, technicians, enumerators, and analysts train the growers and field teams they work alongside, so capability stays behind after we leave.

values.title: Safety
values.description: Safe practice on build sites and in the field, with proper consent and data-protection handling for every respondent we record.

agrisystem-analytics.servicesIntro: We work with smallholders, commercial growers, agribusinesses, NGOs, and development programmes across Ghana and West Africa.

services.title: Low-Cost Greenhouse Construction
services.description: Protected growing structures built from locally available materials, so they can be repaired and extended without importing parts.
items: Site assessment, orientation, and drainage planning
Locally sourced framing, cladding, and insect screening
Internal bed layout and pathway preparation

services.title: Irrigation Setup
services.description: Water delivery matched to the crop, the soil, and the water source actually available on site.
items: Water source assessment and demand calculation
Drip and sprinkler system design and installation

services.title: Supply Chain Mapping & Risk Support
services.description: Visibility across sourcing, aggregation, and distribution, and a clear view of where a value chain is exposed.

services.title: Data Entry & Reporting Support for NGOs
services.description: Field data captured cleanly and turned into the reports donors and boards actually ask for.
items: Enumerator recruitment, training, and field supervision
Data cleaning, validation, and quality checks
Consent handling and data protection practice

services.title: Project Tracking & Outcome Analysis
services.description: Monitoring and evaluation from baseline through to endline, built on indicators agreed before fieldwork starts.
items: Logframe, theory of change, and indicator design
Routine monitoring and field verification visits

agrisystem-analytics.operationalNote: Build teams and field enumerators mobilise from Accra, with analysis and reporting handled in-house.
